common.offline: You are offline. Showing what we last saw.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

trust.message: Your money is held safely. The supplier is paid only after the goods arrive. If the group doesn't fill, you get everything back automatically.

home.title: Buy together. Pay on delivery.
home.tagline: Join traders in your market to buy in bulk at wholesale prices.
home.noPools: You have not joined a group buy yet.

onboarding.title: Create your account
onboarding.phoneHelp: We will send a 6-digit code by SMS.
onboarding.badPhone: Enter a Nigerian mobile number, for example 0803 123 4567.
onboarding.walletBody: We create a secure wallet on this phone. Only you can approve payments, with your fingerprint, face or PIN.
onboarding.backupBody: If you lose this phone you need this backup to get your money back. Write it down and keep it private.
onboarding.testMoneyBody: This is a test version. We add practice money so you can try a payment.

explore.title: Open group buys
explore.empty: No open group buys right now. Check back soon.

pool.organizer: Organized by a trader in your market
pool.indicative: Naira amounts are estimates. You pay the current price now; if the group reaches a better price, the difference comes back to you automatically.
pool.confirmBody: Press confirm to approve. Your money stays in escrow until the goods arrive.
pool.joined: You are in! We will tell you when the price drops.
pool.ifFails: If it doesn't fill or the supplier fails to deliver, you are refunded automatically.
pool.rights: If something is wrong with the goods you can report a problem within 48 hours of delivery.
pool.shareText: Join our group buy: {product}. Price now {price} per unit. {link}
pool.pickupReady: Your goods are ready: collect {count} units.

stateNote.Expired: Not enough people joined. Everyone is being refunded in full.
stateNote.Failed: The order did not go through. Everyone is refunded in full.
stateNote.Cancelled: This group buy was cancelled. Everyone is refunded in full.

pool.pickupReadyShort: Your goods are ready. The organizer will tell you how many units you get.
pool.nextBreakShort: {count} more units and the price drops

organize.title: Organize a group buy
organize.intro: Pick an offer, set a deadline and a pickup place. Share the link with traders in your market.
organize.notOrganizer: You are not an organizer yet. Ask support to approve you.
organize.hubContact: Contact phone at the pickup place
organize.feeHelp: Optional, up to 1%. Members see it before they pay.

delivery.title: Confirm delivery
delivery.intro: Count the goods when they arrive and take photos. This is what pays the supplier.
delivery.short: {count} units short. Members are refunded for the missing goods.

organize.activateHelp: Do this once after support approves you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupWarn: Anyone with this can take your money. Never share it.
settings.passkeyAdd: Add a passkey on this phone
settings.passkeyHelp: Sign in next time with your fingerprint, face or PIN instead of an SMS code.
settings.passkeyDone: Passkey added. You can use it to sign in.
settings.passkeyUnsupported: This phone does not support passkeys.

generic.todo: Please try again. If it keeps happening, contact support.

network.what: We could not reach the server.
network.todo: Check your connection and try again.

declined.what: You did not approve the payment.
declined.todo: Nothing was charged. Try again when you are ready.

OTP_WRONG.todo: Check the SMS and try again.

OTP_RATE_LIMITED.todo: Wait a few minutes and try again.

INVALID_PHONE.what: That phone number is not valid.

FEE_TOO_HIGH.what: This payment needs more fee than we can cover.

unsafe.what: This request looks wrong, so we stopped it.
unsafe.todo: Nothing was charged. Try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.

IMAGE_INVALID.what: That photo could not be read.
IMAGE_INVALID.todo: Take the photo again or choose a different one.

supplier.title: Supplier portal
supplier.applyIntro: Tell us about your business. We verify every supplier before offers go live.
supplier.categories: What you sell (for example rice, beans, oil)
supplier.pending: Your application is being reviewed. We will tell you when it is approved.
supplier.rejected: Your application was not approved. Contact support.
supplier.activateHelp: Do this once after we approve you.
supplier.payout: You will be paid about {amount} after delivery is confirmed

offer.title: New offer
offer.name: Product name
offer.maxUnits: Most units for the whole group
offer.preview: About {usd} USD per unit at today's rate
offer.fxBlocked: Exchange rates are not available right now, so offers cannot be published. Try again shortly.

dispute.title: Report a problem with your goods
dispute.deposit: A small deposit is held while this is decided. You get it back if your report is upheld.
dispute.sent: Your report was sent. An arbiter will decide within 5 days.
dispute.window: You can report a problem until the confirmation time ends.

arbiter.title: Disputes to decide
arbiter.slaPassed: Time is up: the refund will happen automatically.
arbiter.needWallet: Bind your wallet in onboarding first.
arbiter.notArbiter: This area is for arbiters. Ask support if you should have access.

kyb.needsActivation: The supplier must activate their account first.

naira.method: How do you want to pay?
naira.received: Transfer received. Now approve your payment.
naira.unavailable: Naira payments are not available yet.
naira.simulate: Test only: pretend the bank transfer arrived
naira.estimate: You will get about {usd} USD at today's rate. The rate when your transfer arrives is final.
